newsitem.title: FRANCE: Sanofi declines comment on Parke-Davis.
newsitem.headline: Sanofi declines comment on Parke-Davis.

text.p: French drugs group Sanofi declined to comment on Monday on a report in the Lettre de l'Expansion weekly corporate "tip sheet" which said the group was about to announce an alliance with Parke-Davis of the U.S.
Parke-Davis is a unit of Warner-Lambert with which Sanofi already has product development and marketing deals.

"In light of the statements made in December by the board of Elf Aquitaine, Sanofi is studying many cases. These studies are the source of many rumours and Sanofi has decided to not comment on these rumours," a Sanofi spokesman said.
In December, Elf said it was willing to see its majority stake in Sanofi decline to a minority stake in the case of the drugs group striking an alliance deal.
Sanofi's share price opened up 1.65 percent at 553 francs on the Paris bourse.
